subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should maintainers preserve this PR's first-class Tailscale/MagicDNS onboarding path and raw 100.x block on top of the current iOS onboarding refresh?
rationale: The branch overlaps a merged onboarding redesign, has a protected maintainer label, and changes first-run remote setup/security UX, so automation should not decide whether to rebase, narrow, or decline the direction.

options.title: Rebase and repair
options.body: Keep the distinct Tailscale/MagicDNS and raw 100.x blocking behavior, resolve conflicts against current onboarding UI, and fix review findings before merge.

options.title: Narrow into follow-up
options.body: Close or pause this branch and ask for a smaller PR limited to the Tailscale/raw-IP/auth-copy behavior on top of current main.

options.title: Decline this path
options.body: Do not add a first-class Tailscale onboarding chooser until maintainers choose a different iOS remote-setup direction.

recommendation.title: Rebase and repair
recommendation.body: Keep the distinct Tailscale/MagicDNS and raw 100.x blocking behavior, resolve conflicts against current onboarding UI, and fix review findings before merge.
